title: Book: let motion follow the prose, while authorship stays attributable
audience: Creative-technology teams evaluating immersive reading without losing reader control or contribution clarity.
promise: Use an invented chapter and original synthetic music to make a quiet-to-audiovisual arc legible without borrowing the user's book, soundtrack, or other real assets.
story: The synthetic chapter The Signal Room begins as a quiet page, then crosses a narrative threshold before the audiovisual layer peaks.
Four beats keep the prose primary: quiet, threshold, transformation, and exit.
Mute, reduced motion, keyboard navigation, and font scale are part of the intended reader contract, not an afterthought.
A manifest-style authoring view would connect passage, timing, layers, and controls without exposing public admin access.
The selected synthetic case is approved for local material; it makes no authorship claim about the user's book and keeps real repository assets out of scope.
verified_locally: The owner-approved synthetic case uses invented prose, an original copyright-free music motif, original CSS visuals, no real excerpt, no third-party text or recording, no external font, no provider output, and no external mutation.
The intended transformation arc and reader-control contract are represented without importing repository prose or audio.
The contribution ledger keeps writing, direction, implementation, assets, and possible AI assistance separate.
The local packet includes a candidate no-auth source page, short copy, claim ledger, and reviewed 1600x900 binary.
open_gates: Complete BK-2 by authoring the full transformation arc for the selected synthetic case.
Prove synchronization, reader controls, accessibility fallback, and the sanitized authoring view on a current direct surface.
If the showcase later switches to real repository assets, reopen the chapter, music, font, sensitive-content, and AI/human contribution review.
Verify a hosted no-auth case URL and read back each external destination before release.
claim_boundary: This packet proves an owner-approved synthetic reading-to-media target and local material preparation. It does not claim rights clearance for real Book assets, product authorship, live synchronization, accessibility behavior, hosted reader behavior, or external release.
